title: server.remove (platform → host)
description: Disruptive. csm keeps server-N contiguous, so only the highest-numbered server can be removed (others: rejected unsupported), and always with its files (keep_files: true is rejected unsupported). Reliable; answered by exactly one host.result (ref = this message's id). Rejected with `expired` when expires_at is past, and with `stale` when the envelope ts is more than 5 min off the host's clock (a command replayed long after it was sent is not run).
